featured_reviews.review_text:
I decided to go here for hair color- highlights.
Even after an appointment, the person assigned to do my hair, went away for 45 minutes, made me wait. After showing about 20 reference photos, he was still confused on my hair color. He was so slow and almost took 4 hours to do highlights, which seemed like they were not properly done. I felt like the place was all talk and no show. They charged me 9K for this length for regular highlights, the color consumption was also less, I opted for no bleach color and the results came out terrible too: the day it was done it seemed like it was looking fine in the salon. However once I went home and now it has been 2 weeks and I absolutely hate my hair: I had gotten a haircut elsewhere, however the highlights are sooo light and even after so many reference photos this person couldn’t get it right. I am extremely disappointed and felt a little ripped off based on my hair length and color use. On top of that so much time was wasted and the stylist was so slow.

I recently visited for a haircut (my first haircut post lockdown) and I ditched my regular place because I had heard so much about TCC that I wanted it to be my new regular place.

The haircut was amazing and the safety precautions, given the current situation, were also to the point.

I was late for my appointment as there was a bad traffic situation on that particular day due to a vehicle breakdown and most of Bombay was affected by it. I had communicated that I would be late and I requested them to push my appointment, which they did. When I arrived, after sitting in traffic for 2.5 hours, the lady at the reception was super rude and she asked the staff to get done with my haircut quickly and just finish it off soon. I was very uncomfortable throughout the whole experience and I don't think I'll be revisiting. Really disappointed as I loved the haircut and was waiting to visit for a long time.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Highly recommend Nikita if you’re looking for a stylist who really listens, cares, and delivers beautiful results!

featured_reviews.name: K Love
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently did a Facial, Hair Color, and Hair Spa here. The place is super clean and hygienic, but the services are a complete rip-off for the price they charge.

I paid ₹7,500 for a facial and it was extremely disappointing. I clearly told the aesthetician that my skin is sensitive and that I wanted a facial focused on massage, not layers of thick face packs. Unfortunately, she did the exact opposite — it was just a series of face packs with long waiting periods under them (over 40 minutes!). She neither did any proper blackhead or whitehead extraction, nor did my skin look any cleaner afterward. The massage was minimal and had no pressure at all — it didn’t even feel like she was touching my skin. For such a steep price, it was an absolutely poor experience.

The hair color and hair spa were handled by Nisarg, who did a great job, and was very professional. Did an amazing job to my hair, with his knowledge and the type of hair I have.  However, I was disappointed to find that Salon only offers two hair color brands, none of which are ammonia-free. The L’Oréal color cost ₹6,500, and the hair spa ₹3,000 — again, way overpriced.

Even after a 30% discount, my total bill was ₹12,000, which still felt unjustified for the type of service.

To top it off, the checkout experience was unprofessional. They asked if I could pay half in cash because their “credit card machine wasn’t working” — but magically it worked when I refused. Clearly, they were just trying to avoid card transaction fees.

Overall: Clean salon, but prices are inflated for the type of the service they provide. The offerings doesn’t match the rates, and the professionalism at checkout is questionable.
I will never return unless prices and service standards are fixed.
